MARSRIVA KP9 Pro 24000mAh Smart Mini DC UPS for Router

The MARSRIVA KP9 Pro 24000mAh Smart Mini DC UPS is a high-capacity power backup solution designed to keep your router, ONU, IP camera, and other low-power devices running without interruption. With its powerful 24000mAh battery, multiple DC output ports, and intelligent power management, the KP9 Pro ensures stable connectivity during load-shedding, power failures, and voltage fluctuations—making it the perfect choice for homes, offices, and small businesses in Bangladesh.

This smart DC UPS supports 9V, 12V, and 24V output, allowing wide compatibility with most WiFi routers, dual-band routers, ONT/ONU devices, CCTV cameras, and mini network switches. It provides seamless switching, zero delay backup, and built-in protection features including overcharge, over-discharge, overload, and short-circuit protection. For anyone looking for reliable, long-lasting router backup power, the MARSRIVA KP9 Pro is one of the best options in BD.


Key Features:


  • High-capacity 24000mAh battery for extended backup time
  • Supports 9V / 12V / 24V DC output for universal device compatibility
  • Perfect for WiFi Routers, ONU, IP Cameras, POE Switches
  • Zero-transition seamless backup for uninterrupted internet
  • Smart digital protection: overcharge, over-discharge & short-circuit protection
  • Durable build quality, compact and portable design
  • Ideal for homes, offices, and networking setups
  • Energy-efficient operation with long battery lifespan
